label: Distinct motion and efficient witnesses bypass unrestricted self-cause assumptions
summary: The cause-fork theorem uses coverage for a single selected route relation at Unit, and the self-perfection witness contradicts that ban on its CAUSE_2 branch. The q.77 a.6 witness supports qualified natural resultance. The move and origin transfers require separate grounds on the efficient relation. On motion, select one actual mover and keep the moved patient without the completed act, bypassing diagonal reconstruction, internal-to-whole transfer and unrestricted whole actuality in this route. An explicit finite motion roster retains both component and aggregate attributions. The Second Way descent uses one distinct incoming efficient witness per effect, and no CAUSE_4 origin with the weaker bridge supports that coverage under explicit excluded middle. Temporal composition restricts the all-time ban to self-uniting tuples. Finite controls certify strictness of the three registered strength relations. The earlier no-self-origin route remains conditional on diagonal productive-exercise coverage and its production-order premises. These results establish no philosophical premise.
blocker: The source claim still needs the actual same-bearer CAUSE_2 application. The narrower origin bridge needs a defended account of diagonal efficient edges with no distinct incoming candidate. The Second Way endpoint needs a same-bearer interface to the case’s existential dependence and necessity vocabulary. The original SELF_MOTION reconstruction and whole-actuality route preserve their open bridges.

current_assessment.scope: No-self-cause scope for the motion, efficient descent and temporal uniter routes
current_assessment.assessment: The productive-exercise interpretation gives conditional warrant for strict exclusion of a bearer producing its own being. It leaves qualified proper-accident resultance and part-mediated motion available. Select a single act predicate for the distinct-mover inference and a single efficient relation for the distinct incoming descent. The universal route ban requires its own relation choice. The source supports qualified resultance, with application to the reflexive perfection predicate still open. The optional origin proof uses excluded middle only for equality of the two endpoints of a witnessed efficient edge. Local equality decisions on those edges suffice. The descent concludes double-negated existence and supplies no designated bearer.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix a bearer with diagonal efficient activity and check whether it has a distinct incoming cause anywhere in the same selected relation. For the root interface check whether the selected first efficient bearer is underived in the existential dependence sense. For temporal composition test an actual unit whose acquisition of being owes to a self-uniting act by that same bearer.
